{{Term/Store|Kairo||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|Kairo|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Kairo|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref>

==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Kairo is a [[Goron]] who travels the [[Mountain Road]] between [[Foothill Stable]] and the end of the [[Maw of Death Mountain]]. At the end of his trail, he stops to search for Gems before heading back.<ref>{{Cite|Let's find some ore to sell.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He used to work at the [[Goron Hot Springs]], but he grew bored there and decided to travel the world as a [[Merchant]].<ref>{{Cite|I got plain sick and tired of working the Goron Hot Springs in {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}}, so I decided to just up and leave.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He carries a [[Traveling Pack]] on his journeys.

[[Goron City]] is Kairo's hometown, and the reason he is so far away is to sell the Gems he has mined from [[Death Mountain]].<ref>{{Cite|My hometown of {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}} is the fifth stop up the trail. I'm just out here selling the ore I dug up from {{Color BotW|Blue|Death Mountain}}.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|The chunks of ore I dug up from {{Color BotW|Blue|Death Mountain}} are pretty high quality. Take a look and you'll dig 'em too!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> While he admits that the area can be dangerous at times, he claims there is an abundance of Gems to mine.<ref>{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}} is the fifth stop on this road. It can be a pretty dangerous place, but there's a lot of ore to be mined.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He also mentions that he is friends with [[Yunobo]], and he wonders how he is doing while he is away.<ref>{{Cite|I wonder how my old buddy {{Color BotW|Red|Yunobo}} back in {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}} is doing. Nice guy, that {{Color BotW|Red|Yunobo}}. Always a pleasure to chomp the ore with.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref>

Kairo considers himself to be more suited for the life of traveling Merchant, as he enjoys the scenery he sees along the way.<ref>{{Cite|I am more suited to the life of a traveling merchant for sure. The scenery is much nicer than the {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron Hot Springs}}.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|I'm digging this greenery.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|What great scenery.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He wants to see parts of the world he otherwise would not be able to in [[Goron City]], such as cold locations, green [[Tree]]s, and hills.<ref>{{Cite|I'm going to see the world! I want to see somewhere cold, I want to see green trees and hills!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He is interested in the [[Weather]] further away from Death Mountain, as there are no [[Magma Bomb]]s falling from the sky.<ref>{{Cite|Is it normal for magma bombs to not rain down nonstop? I just don't understand the weather around here.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref>

Since [[Link]] is a [[Hylian]], Kairo warns him that he will need a way to protect himself from the [[Scorching Climate]] if he continues past the Maw of Death Mountain.<ref>{{Cite|You do not look to be made of rock, so here's some advice: you'll need some fire protection if you go any farther.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|mountain road}} is pretty dangerous because of how hot it gets. If you're taking a trip to {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}}, be sure to bring some fire protection.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He recommends the use of a [[Fireproof Elixir]], but he is unable to remember any of the ingredients required beyond a [[Fireproof Lizard]].<ref>{{Cite|I recommend a {{Color BotW|Red|fireproof elixir}}. You can make it by cooking a {{Color BotW|Red|fireproof lizard}} with a... A, um... Huh, I forget what else.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|A {{Color BotW|Red|fireproof elixir}} will help a little Hylian like you stand up to this heat. Just cook a {{Color BotW|Red|fireproof lizard}} with a... With a, um... Huh. I just can't remember.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He also warns Link about Magma Bombs, as getting hit by them would even hurt a Goron.<ref>{{Cite|Getting hit by a {{Color BotW|Blue|magma bomb}} even hurts us Gorons! If you're thinking about going for a climb on {{Color BotW|Blue|Death Mountain}}, you had better be careful.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|If you're heading to {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}}'s famed {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron Hot Springs}}, watch out for magma bombs on the way. I haven't had to worry about them since leaving to travel the world, and I do NOT miss dodging those things.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref>

Along his route, Kairo may be attacked by [[Fire Chuchu]]s or other [[Monster]]s. If Link saves him, he may share his relief to live another day.<ref>{{Cite|Looks like I'll live to sell another day!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He also has a chance to remark that he finds monsters to be scary.<ref>{{Cite|Those monsters are pretty scary.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> As a reward, he will give Link [[Hasty Steamed Mushrooms]], a [[Sneaky Elixir]], a [[Fireproof Elixir]], or [[Rupee]]s.<ref>{{Cite|I survived? All right! Here, take this as a thank you, brother.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref>

Kairo sells a limited selection of [[Gem]]s at a fairly low price.<ref>{{Cite|I have some rare ore burning a hole in my pack! Take your time looking it over, and let me know what you want.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|All right, let's get down to brass tacks. Feel free to browse my wares!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> During [[Rain]], Kairo will add rare Gems, such as [[Diamond]], to his lineup.<ref>{{Cite|This weather has me in a rare mood to sell rare ore. How about a {{Color BotW|Red|diamond}}? You interested in rare items?|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> When Link buys from Kairo, he shows his appreciation for his business.<ref name="Appreciate">{{Cite|I appreciate your business, brother!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Good doing business with you!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Thank you for stopping by, brother!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|That's the last of it. I'm all sold out! Thanks for your business, brother!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref>

As with all other Merchants, Kairo will buy [[Item]]s from Link as well.<ref>{{Cite|I can buy some things from you.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|I'll buy whatever it is you're selling.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|I'll buy anything. Just try me!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|If you have anything you don't need, I'll be glad to buy it off you.|Kairo|BotW}}</ref> He is grateful for any wares he is able to purchase from Link.<ref>{{Cite|Thanks for your business, brother!|Kairo|BotW}}</ref><ref name="Appreciate"/><ref>{{Cite|It's been a pleasure! Need anything else?|Kairo|BotW}}</ref>

==={{TotK|-}}===
Kairo is no longer a merchant but is still traveling in {{TotK}}. He now travels with [[Zorona]]. According to [[Zorona]], Kairo had such a bad sense of direction that it inspired Zorona to travel with Kairo.<ref>{{Cite|We used to be solo travelers too, until we ran into each other on the road. The big lump's got no sense of direction at all. Would you believe he forgot the way to Goron City, his hometown? I couldn't bear to watch him flail around, so now we're travel buddies.|Zorona|TotK}}</ref> This works out well for the two of them, as Zorona is also a terrible cook and can rely on Kairo.<ref>{{Cite|Hahaha, all right, you win. I'll stop, since I can't cook to save my life. That's why we're such good traveling buddies. We make up for each other's weaknesses.|Zorona|TotK}}</ref>

Kairo partially blames the recent geographic changes surrounding [[Goron City]] for his poor direction, but Zorona constantly teases him nevertheless.<ref>{{Cite|Lay off! I'm embarrassed enough as it is! Besides, it's not that I forgot. When I left the city, there was still lava everywhere. I didn't know Death Mountain would stop erupting, the lava would cool, and new roads would form!|Kairo|TotK}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|You're a Goron. You should know the way to Goron City. How in the name of Hylia did you forget?|Zorona|TotK}}</ref>  

Link can watch as [[Scorpis]] gives directions to Zorona and Kairo and then meet up with them as they travel from [[Lookout Landing]] to [[Riverside Stable]], to next to a tree on the path between [[Wetland Stable]] and [[Kakariko Village]], and finally to just outside [[Gerudo Town]].

Along the way, Kairo often remarks how he wants to taste the [[Ring Ruin]]s though Link will never meet up with the two in [[Kakariko Village]].<ref>{{Cite|Oof, I'm hungry... You SURE I can't have a taste of the Ring Ruins? A little nibble?|Kairo|TotK}}</ref> Later at [[Gerudo Town]], Kairo will repeatedly demand for him and [[Zorona]] to be allowed in as he is under the assumption that another male friend of his was allowed.<ref>{{Cite|My friend told me he got in! If we keep asking, they'll let us in too!|Kairo|TotK}}</ref> While it is never said who this friend is, it is likely [[Lyndae]] or [[Strade]] as both of these [[Goron]]s were allowed in during {{BotW}}.
